name: India
note: Crop-residue burning (wheat Apr-May, paddy Oct-Nov) + dry-season forest fires (Feb-May)

meta.method: GIBS WMTS vector tiles (FIRMS-derived MODIS C6.1 / VIIRS V2 thermal anomalies), z5 9° tiles, 6 evenly spaced sampled day(s)/month, scaled to a monthly estimate, bbox-filtered. Sensors: MODIS-Terra, MODIS-Aqua, VIIRS-SNPP, VIIRS-NOAA20, VIIRS-NOAA21.
meta.source: NASA GIBS https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov · data NASA FIRMS/LANCE
